reviews.disposition:
F1: Full content review covers the989-line frozen JSON, all six root/19world fields, three lotm1appearance/behavior/office rules,17unique evidence objects with full claim/member/hash/paragraph/qualification, continuity, selected trope, two small interactions/two original voices/five stable people/four unknowns/five native gaps/four deferred gates, three topology structures/two edges and five deep-chain phases/four outcomes. Every field and evidence object was actually read through an evidence-factored projection whose decoding equals original; this equality is representational, not semantic proof. Original JSON/schema/bytes stay unchanged.

F2: The Chinese first-novel SHA6126274478a95dbe03eb904bc35c409067c7022563e52997a46e98be07b2d70d and seven disjoint member ranges total363integratedstoryitems. Later1402reader-read and47paratext are different states, not this map’s full semantic scope. Current English-v1 Klein work in PROJECT does not change this Chinese snapshot by arithmetic. Manifest/coverage/source-hash booleans are historical pins, not freshly verified source files or product adoption. Source event, narrator, explanation, character assessment and Audrey inference retain qualifiers; no raw chapter/notes body was newly read.

F3: Appearance/admission, habitual behavior, actual actor/body/controller, institutional right, retinue/debt, native source and stored soul stay separate. Observed incongruity supports suspicion, not an identity verdict. Disguise starts before victim death in the captured source reading; killing is not its established activation condition. Stored-slot replacement differs from active-mode switching and actual latency; fragmentary autobiographical access is not universal perfect memory. The registry helper is original comparison machinery, not every noble institution’s canonical office process. Ordinary attendance/report/withdrawal/protection and disputed credit remain viable, without granting another actor’s faculty or rewriting source outcome.

F4: Private lead, received warning, useful outcome, public/proxy attribution, promised estate, available cash and actual settlement are distinct. A later credit claim is not automatically paid from an institution’s stock. Original voices/meter humor and clerical work remain labelled original; paid meter/actual money, shift/time and learned occult mastery have separate suppliers. Gray-fog representation of one carried pendulum is not a duplicate physical item or transport proof. Dream/perception contact conveys a selected received message, not bestowed source power or team-wide knowledge; grayfog/spiritworld distinctions and clocks remain qualified.

F5: Current selected header687–743still reports this specific recognition adapter unactivated/nativeBound=false. The actual source referenceRegistryComparison53–81 uses lotm1office in an original Village host with supplied native body/right/registry/report owners; the catalogue registers declarations without spawning native worlds. This establishes selected code joins, not a fresh executed comparison or the five-phase source reception chain. It does not negate the separate current English-v1 Klein campaign. No current host gameplay/save/UI proof is added. Parent worker labels are historical; map director-acceptance gate is optional under AD42. Keep source-native actor/fuel/latency/custody/observer/settlement/clock gaps distinct from the usable pure comparison.

A represented Nightmare collapse does not certify literal historical time travel, every passenger route or a universal outside clock. Post-theft exceptions cannot rewrite early Shore history implicitly. Native Dream/Spell/fate/body/essence/material/observer/history/return consumers remain named gaps in this map; frozen parent-integration-required is a historical worker boundary, not a fresh whole-checkout absence claim. Preserve ordinary cooperation, source-specific lost activation conditions and observer-limited reencounter as proposals, without activating source people/worlds or a full native chain.
